primary_claim: Cross-layer transcoders (CLTs) can learn to rewrite genuine multi-hop circuits into shallow single-hop shortcuts that skip intermediate computation while still achieving perfect reconstruction accuracy -- demonstrated directly in a hand-crafted Boolean toy model where the trained CLT never activates any layer-1 features despite the ground-truth model requiring a real two-step computation -- and the CLT sparsity loss structurally incentivizes this shortcut because additional decoder vectors to downstream layers are nearly free once a feature is active, with supporting but non-definitive evidence that the same asymmetric-L0 pattern and diverging circuit interpretations occur in GPT-2 and Gemma-2-2B.

effect.metric: per-layer L0 (active features) and cumulative attribution contribution by layer depth, CLT vs PLT
effect.value: Boolean toy model: CLT achieves 100% replacement accuracy with layer-1 L0 = 0.0 (vs PLT's 0.94), never using layer-1 features for a computation that genuinely requires them; GPT-2-small: CLT layer-0 L0 is often >3x higher than later layers while jointly-trained PLTs show similar L0 across layers; Gemma-2-2B: CLT attribution circuits concentrate almost all top-logit contribution in layers 0-1, while PLT attribution grows roughly linearly with depth

contradicts_or_qualifies: Extends prior findings that per-layer transcoders (PLTs) can be unfaithful (Anthropic's toy-model faithfulness work) by showing cross-layer transcoders have a distinct and more severe unfaithfulness mode: collapsing genuine multi-step circuits into shallow single-hop shortcuts, incentivized by the CLT sparsity loss's near-free additional decoder vectors.
stated_future_work: Separate decoder norm penalties per layer instead of penalizing the concatenated decoder vector, removing the cost asymmetry that incentivizes shortcuts (considered the most promising near-term experiment)
Limit feature span via local/windowed CLT decoders (e.g. only the next k downstream layers) to force multi-step computation to use multiple features
Add auxiliary faithfulness losses that reward features whose activations correlate with actual per-layer neuron activations, not just output reconstruction
Add regularization penalizing extreme L0 asymmetry across layers
limitations_stated: The primary demonstration uses an extremely small hand-crafted toy model (16 possible inputs, a simple boolean function) that may not represent computations in real language models, where lookup-table shortcuts may be infeasible in higher dimensions
The evidence from Gemma-2-2B is suggestive but not definitive: without ground-truth circuits, it cannot be certain whether the CLT or PLT interpretation is correct in that case
The analysis focused only on MLPs and did not examine attention layers, which may exhibit different failure modes
quote: the CLT learns two parallel single-hop circuits, thus being unfaithful to the ground truth.
